prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait background plate for a brief mobile app opening animation. This is NOT a screenshot or app mockup. Create just the artwork, edge to edge, portrait 2:3.
Primary request: a beautifully composed, close and welcoming mosque garden courtyard designed for a straight camera push forward through a portal. The app visual language is tactile premium stylized 3D: softly rounded ivory stone architecture, rich deep emerald green, restrained warm gold trim, sculpted materials and very soft ambient shadows. Match the feel of a carefully crafted 3D mosque app icon expanded into a convincing architectural world, with mature elegant proportions rather than a toy palace.
Scene: camera at human eye height inside a quiet courtyard, looking along a short clear pale stone approach toward an inviting large central pointed-arch entrance of a small elegant mosque prayer pavilion. The pavilion is close, substantial and richly legible, NOT a tiny building far away. Its ivory facade, emerald inset doorway, green dome and subtle gold finial should form the focal destination. The central entrance is softly open and reveals another shaded arch beyond, giving real visual depth. Low clipped greenery, a few olive leaves and cream colonnades at the extreme left and right frame the approach without crowding it. No fountain or pool blocking the path. The viewpoint is perfectly centered and straight, with realistic one-point perspective and clean architectural logic.
Composition: purpose-built vertical 2:3 composition that still reads when the center is enlarged 2x. The central pavilion and entrance occupy roughly the middle 50 percent of image width and the middle 55 percent of image height. The doorway itself is clearly visible near the center, slightly above mid-height. Foreground paving takes only the lower quarter and gently leads inward. Sky is at most the upper 12 percent, softly muted. Side colonnades and plants stay near the margins. Keep the central approach uncluttered, no big foreground arch across the image: an animated gold arch will be overlaid outside this image. No enormous empty sky or distant horizon. Keep important dome and central doorway within the central 65 percent of image width.
Lighting: warm early morning side light, delicate golden reflections on cream stone, shaded emerald recesses, subtle atmospheric depth. Serene, inviting, polished, believable. Color harmony dominated by ivory #f5f0e6, forest emerald #003b29, darker green #001b16 and restrained gold #e2bf77. Avoid strong orange, electric blue or shiny plastic. Finish with crisp refined 3D rendering and gentle soft-edged material shading; no grunge or painterly brush strokes.
Constraints: no people, no writing, no Arabic lettering, no logos, no captions, no UI, no watermark, no picture frame. Portrait image only.
